projectDescription: Concrete is an institutional-grade DeFi platform that automates yield generation across multiple chains, allowing users to deposit once and earn risk-adjusted returns through managed vault strategies.
keyFeatures: One-click DeFi yield access through automated vault strategies
Institutional-grade vault infrastructure with daily NAV updates
ct[Asset] yield-bearing vault share tokens composable across DeFi
Role-based automation with separation of duties (Vault Manager, Allocator, Strategy Manager)
Multi-chain yield routing across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Berachain, and more
Real-time security monitoring via Hypernative and ZeroShadow integration
Noncustodial vault curation on Morpho for institutional lending markets
Enterprise vault deployment with custom strategy and SDK integration
AssetCX product for custodians earning yield on off-chain assets
Audited by Cantina, Code4rena, Halborn, and Zellic
publicApiSurface: Concrete Earn App (app.concrete.xyz/earn) — deposit and manage vault positions
ct[Asset] tokens — yield-bearing vault shares (e.g. ctDefiUSDT, ctWBTC)
Exchange Rate (eRate) — vault share valuation metric
Net Asset Value (NAV) — total vault asset valuation
Withdrawal queue — orderly daily processing cycle for redemptions
Enterprise vault SDK — hosted UI or SDK integration for custom vaults
AssetCX — custodian yield-earning product for institutional assets
